entries.message: "push" ignores only some branches ("branches-ignore") and "pull_request" is used too, so a commit pushed to a branch of this repository that has a pull request runs the workflow twice. limit "push" to the branches that need it, for example the default branch

secret "ACTIONS_PAT_GITHUB" is passed to a reusable workflow by a job which cannot have an "environment:", so it is a repository or organization secret exposed to every job that asks for it. pass a token that the called workflow mints, let a job of the called workflow use an environment of its own, or inline the workflow in a job with an environment
